notes: v1.0.80 - THE REAL Fabric 1.21.x fix. Root cause found: the launcher was missing the net.fabricmc:intermediary mappings jar, which Fabric Loader needs to remap mods intermediary classTweaker entries to the official runtime on OBFUSCATED versions like 1.21.11 (1.21.11 is the last obfuscated release; 26.1+ ships unobfuscated and needs no intermediary - that is why 26.2 always worked). installFabric now adds and downloads intermediary for versions below 26, and EXISTING broken 1.21.x installs self-heal on next launch (JSON patched + jar downloaded in place, nothing deleted). Your PVP Practice instance was already patched so it can launch even before updating.
